item.title: Shettima Defends Tax Reforms, Says They Will Ease Burden on Nigerians
item.description: Vice President says reforms will remove multiple levies, reduce poverty and improve livelihoods despite criticism from political opponents.

item.title: CBN Boosts Gold Reserves To $3.5bn As Senate Moves To Make Apex Bank Lead Fintech Regulator
item.description: CBN raises gold reserves to $3.5bn with domestically sourced bullion as Senate pushes fintech oversight and anti-Ponzi crackdown.

item.title: Security Agencies Lock Down Abuja As US-Israel-Iran War Escalates, US Embassy Suspends Visa Appointments
item.description: Security tightens in Abuja as Middle East war intensifies, US Embassy cancels visas and global oil fears rise.

item.title: Disu Takes Oath As 23rd IGP, Declares State Police ‘Has Come To Stay’
item.description: New IGP Olatunji Disu says state police has come to stay, pledges neutrality, welfare reforms and intelligence-driven policing.

item.title: TCN Says $1.3bn Donor-Funded Power Transmission Projects Ongoing Across Nigeria
item.description: Transmission Company of Nigeria says $1.3bn donor-funded projects expand grid capacity, modernise infrastructure and strengthen nationwide power delivery.

item.title: National Assembly Launches Women’s Caucus Ahead Of Special Seats Constitutional Vote
item.description: National Assembly inaugurates Women’s Caucus to boost female representation as constitutional amendment vote on Special Seats approaches.

item.title: NSE Urges Engineers To Deploy Smart Solutions To Tackle Nigeria’s Insecurity
item.description: NSE calls on engineers to use smart technologies, digital tools, and innovation to support government in improving security.

item.title: Tinubu Reappoints Prof. Ayo Omotayo As NIPSS Director-General For Four-Year Term
item.description: President Tinubu approves final four-year term for Prof. Ayo Omotayo, continuing leadership at NIPSS, Kuru.

item.title: Soyinka, Osofisan, Osundare, ASUU Leaders Celebrate Professor Biodun Jeyifo At Evening Of Tributes
item.description: Prominent Nigerians celebrated Professor Biodun Jeyifo’s life, highlighting his scholarship, Marxist ideals, and foundational role in ASUU’s growth.
